classes.name: index
classes.reason: _consume reads each index file once per unit inside a budget_ns window broadcast from the producers' emit time, abandoning the unit as 'dropped' when probe.NS() - started > budget_ns, and only the consumer rank is issuing those reads (producers write, a different rank reads).

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report loops STATISTICS_READS=8 passes of probe.read_staged over each statistics file with no budget check, so the consumer rank stalls on each synchronous open/pread while other ranks are not waiting on that particular access.
